library(tidyverse)

# Load Data

```{r}
# Adjust path as needed
# catch_original <- read_csv("data/salmon_catch.csv")
glimpse(catch_original)
```

# SELECT

```{r}
catch_data <- catch_original %>%
  select(Region, Year, Chinook, Sockeye, Coho, Pink, Chum)

catch_data <- catch_original %>%
  select(-All, -notesRegCode)

glimpse(catch_data)
```

# MUTATE – Type Conversion

```{r}
catch_clean <- catch_data %>%
  mutate(Chinook = as.numeric(Chinook))

i <- which(is.na(catch_clean$Chinook))
i
catch_data[i, ]
```

# MUTATE with if_else Fix

```{r}
catch_clean <- catch_data %>%
  mutate(
    Chinook = if_else(Chinook == "I", "1", Chinook),
    Chinook = as.numeric(Chinook)
  )

catch_clean[i, ]
```

# PIVOT LONGER

```{r}
catch_long <- catch_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Region, Year),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "catch"
  )

catch_long
```

# PIVOT WIDER

```{r}
catch_wide <- catch_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = catch
  )

catch_wide
```

# RENAME

```{r}
catch_long <- catch_long %>%
  rename(catch_thousands = catch)

catch_long
```

# UNIT CONVERSION

```{r}
catch_long <- catch_long %>%
  mutate(catch = catch_thousands * 1000) %>%
  select(-catch_thousands)

catch_long
```

# GROUP BY + SUMMARIZE

```{r}
mean_region <- catch_long %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarize(mean_catch = mean(catch))

mean_region
```

# COUNTING

```{r}
catch_long %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarize(n = n())

catch_long %>% count(Region)
```

# FILTER

```{r}
sse_catch <- catch_long %>%
  filter(Region == "SSE")

chinook_sse <- catch_long %>%
  filter(Region == "SSE",
         species == "Chinook")

sse_catch
chinook_sse
```

# ARRANGE

```{r}
mean_region %>% arrange(mean_catch)
mean_region %>% arrange(desc(mean_catch))
```

# SEPARATE

```{r}
sites_df <- tibble(site = c("HAW-101", "MOL-023"))

sites_df %>%
  separate(site, c("island", "site_number"), "-")
```

# UNITE

```{r}
dates_df <- tibble(year = 1930, month = 12, day = 14)

dates_df %>%
  unite(date, year, month, day, sep = "-")
```

# COMPLETE PIPELINE

```{r}
mean_region_pipeline <- catch_original %>%
  select(-All, -notesRegCode) %>%
  mutate(Chinook = if_else(Chinook == "I", "1", Chinook)) %>%
  mutate(Chinook = as.numeric(Chinook)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -c(Region, Year),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "catch"
  ) %>%
  mutate(catch = catch * 1000) %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarize(mean_catch = mean(catch)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_catch))

mean_region_pipeline
```
